item.title: GraphQuon 2025 — University of Toronto
item.description: GraphQuon is the annual Quebec–Ontario pre-SIGGRAPH workshop. The 2025 edition ran 15–16 November 2025 at the University of Toronto (series page). I presented there with Sheldon Andrews (ÉTS): Where to Wear? — how frictional contact leaves a readable history on surfaces, and how we can turn that into graphics and engineering feedback. Version française.

item.title: GraphQuon 2024 — ÉTS (Montréal)
item.description: GraphQuon (formerly MOTOGRAPH) is the annual Quebec–Ontario pre-SIGGRAPH workshop for East-Canadian computer graphics labs. The 2024 edition ran 9–10 November 2024 at École de technologie supérieure (ÉTS) in Montréal. I helped build and host the conference website at graphquon.github.io so schedules, registration, and past editions stayed in one place. Version française.
